message:
Hey friends! 🌟 I recently stumbled upon a great resource about power outages, and it got me thinking about all the low-tech fun we can have when the lights go out. Remember board games? Candlelit dinners? Those cozy moments can really bring us together as a family. It’s a perfect opportunity to unplug and enjoy each other's company without distractions. 

If you’ve got your own tips for making the most of a blackout, I’d love to hear them!
